# Invoice contents (CNT)

What every invoice has to say: when one is due, who the parties are, how operations and taxes are shown, and the mentions some operations require.

Rules page: https://docs.beel.es/rules/contents

"Checked by: Your integration" or "The issuing business" means BeeL. does not enforce the rule, beyond any error codes it lists: the integration has to.

## CNT-001

**Every operation of the business is invoiced, exempt ones included**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: medium · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Issue an invoice, full or simplified, for every supply of goods or services the business makes, including operations that are not subject to VAT or are exempt, except where the invoicing regulation says one is not needed.

**Why:** A missing invoice is a breach of the invoicing obligation in itself, whatever tax it would have carried.

**Applies to:** Every supply of goods or services made in the course of business.

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 2.1 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a2

**Incorrect:** Leaving a course taught to a customer out of the books because it is exempt from VAT.

**Correct:** Invoicing the course with a line classified as exempt, so the invoice states the exemption.

**Related:** CNT-002, CNT-010

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/tax-classification#the-four-families

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CNT-001.md

## CNT-002

**A business customer always gets an invoice**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: medium · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

When the recipient is a business or professional acting as such, or asks for an invoice to exercise a tax right, issue a full invoice that identifies them. A receipt or ticket is not enough.

**Why:** Without an invoice the customer cannot deduct the VAT, and the issuer breaches its invoicing obligation.

**Applies to:** invoice types `STANDARD`; The recipient is a business or professional acting as such, or asks for an invoice to exercise a tax right.

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 2.2.a) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a2

**Incorrect:** Selling to a company at the counter and handing over only a simplified invoice without its NIF.

**Correct:** Issuing a STANDARD invoice with the company's legal name, NIF and address.

**Related:** CNT-005, SIM-006, SIM-009

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/simplified-vs-standard#on-the-f1-path

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CNT-002.md

## CNT-003

**A full invoice names both parties by their legal name**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: high · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. rejects a request that breaks it.

A full invoice shows the full name or legal name of the issuer and of the recipient. Send the recipient's legal_name, not a trade name; BeeL. takes the issuer's from the company's tax profile and does not issue while that profile is incomplete.

**Why:** The legal name is what identifies each party for tax purposes; a trade name alone does not.

**Applies to:** invoice types `STANDARD`, `CORRECTIVE`; operations `createCompanyInvoice`, `createCompanyCustomer`

**Error codes:** [`RECIPIENT_FISCAL_NAME_REQUIRED`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/RECIPIENT_FISCAL_NAME_REQUIRED), [`PROFILE_INCOMPLETE`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/PROFILE_INCOMPLETE)

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 6.1.c) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a6

**Incorrect:** Sending only the shop name the customer trades under.

```json
{ "recipient": { "trade_name": "Café Central", "nif": "B12345678" } }
```

**Correct:** Sending the legal name as registered, with the trade name as an extra.

```json
{ "recipient": { "legal_name": "Cafeterías Centrales SL", "trade_name": "Café Central", "nif": "B12345678" } }
```

**Related:** CNT-004, CNT-005, CNT-006

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/simplified-vs-standard#on-the-f1-path

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CNT-003.md

## CNT-004

**Every invoice shows the issuer's NIF**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: medium · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. rejects a request that breaks it.

Every invoice carries the NIF the issuer operates with. BeeL. uses the NIF of the issuing company and does not submit an invoice to VeriFactu while the company has none.

**Why:** The issuer's NIF is what AEAT files the invoice and its record under.

**Applies to:** invoice types `STANDARD`, `SIMPLIFIED`, `CORRECTIVE`

**Error codes:** [`COMPANY_NIF_MISSING`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/COMPANY_NIF_MISSING)

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 6.1.d) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a6

**Incorrect:** Issuing invoices for a company whose NIF was never set in its profile.

**Correct:** Completing the company's NIF before its first invoice; each NIF issues through its own company.

**Related:** CNT-003, REC-005

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/compliance-and-responsibilities#the-issuing-business

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CNT-004.md

## CNT-005

**A full invoice identifies the recipient by NIF**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: high · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. rejects a request that breaks it.

Send the recipient's NIF, or an alternative identifier for a customer without a Spanish NIF, on every standard invoice. The NIF is mandatory by law for exempt intra-EU supplies of goods, reverse-charge operations and operations located in Spain by an issuer established here.

**Why:** Without the recipient's identification the invoice does not meet the legal content, and the customer cannot deduct its VAT.

**Applies to:** invoice types `STANDARD`, `CORRECTIVE`; operations `createCompanyInvoice`

**Error codes:** [`RECIPIENT_ID_REQUIRED`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/RECIPIENT_ID_REQUIRED), [`EXEMPTION_REQUIRES_RECIPIENT_ID_TYPE`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/EXEMPTION_REQUIRES_RECIPIENT_ID_TYPE)

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 6.1.d) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a6

**Incorrect:** Creating a standard invoice for a Spanish company with only its name and address: it is rejected with RECIPIENT_ID_REQUIRED.

**Correct:** Sending the company's NIF with its legal name and address.

```json
{ "type": "STANDARD", "recipient": { "legal_name": "Cafeterías Centrales SL", "nif": "B12345678", "address": { "street": "Calle Mayor 1", "postal_code": "28013", "city": "Madrid", "province": "Madrid" } } }
```

**Related:** CNT-020, CNT-021, TAX-004

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/simplified-vs-standard#on-the-f1-path · https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/international-customers#identifying-foreign-customers

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CNT-005.md

## CNT-006

**A full invoice shows the address of both parties**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: medium · Checked by: Your integration. BeeL. rejects the cases listed under the error codes; the rest is yours to check.

A full invoice shows the address of the issuer and of the recipient. Send the recipient's fiscal address, also on customers you store; BeeL. rejects an invoice without one only when the recipient is sent inline.

**Why:** The address is part of the legal content of a full invoice; an invoice without the recipient's address is incomplete and has to be corrected.

**Applies to:** invoice types `STANDARD`, `CORRECTIVE`; operations `createCompanyInvoice`, `createCompanyCustomer`

**Error codes:** [`RECIPIENT_ADDRESS_REQUIRED`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/RECIPIENT_ADDRESS_REQUIRED), [`PROFILE_INCOMPLETE`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/PROFILE_INCOMPLETE)

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 6.1.e) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a6

**Incorrect:** Invoicing a stored customer imported without an address.

**Correct:** Completing the customer's address before invoicing it, or sending the recipient inline with its address.

**Related:** CNT-003, CNT-005

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/simplified-vs-standard#on-the-f1-path

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CNT-006.md

## CNT-007

**Each line describes the operation, its unit price and any discount**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: medium · Checked by: Your integration. BeeL. rejects the cases listed under the error codes; the rest is yours to check.

Describe each operation with the data needed to work out its taxable base: a meaningful description, the unit price without tax, and any discount not already included in that price. Send the discount as discount_percentage rather than folding it into the price.

**Why:** A line that does not say what was supplied or at what price does not let anyone check the taxable base.

**Applies to:** invoice types `STANDARD`, `CORRECTIVE`; operations `createCompanyInvoice`

**Error codes:** [`LINE_NORMAL_DESCRIPTION_REQUIRED`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/LINE_NORMAL_DESCRIPTION_REQUIRED), [`LINE_INVALID_DISCOUNT`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/LINE_INVALID_DISCOUNT)

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 6.1.f) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a6

**Incorrect:** A single line described as Services with the discount already subtracted from the price.

**Correct:** A line that says what was supplied, with its net unit price and the discount apart.

```json
{ "description": "Website maintenance, September 2026", "quantity": 1, "unit_price": 500, "discount_percentage": 10 }
```

**Related:** CNT-008, CNT-009

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/amounts-and-rounding#three-ways-to-price-a-line

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CNT-007.md

## CNT-008

**The tax rate and the tax amount are shown apart from the base**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: medium · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. does this for you.

A full invoice states the tax rate applied and the tax amount charged, separately from the taxable base. You choose the rate of each line; BeeL. computes the tax amount of each rate and shows it apart from the base.

**Why:** The VAT charged is what the customer deducts; it has to be readable on its own, next to the rate it comes from.

**Applies to:** invoice types `STANDARD`, `CORRECTIVE`

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 6.1.g) y h) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a6
- Ley 37/1992 del IVA, art. 88.Dos — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1992-28740#a88

**Incorrect:** Sending a line with a price that already includes VAT as if it were the net price, so the base and the tax amount on the invoice are wrong.

**Correct:** Sending the net price with its main_tax, or pricing the line with total_including_tax so BeeL. works the base and the tax out of the total.

**Related:** CNT-009, TAX-001, REC-012

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/amounts-and-rounding#taxes-are-rounded-per-group-not-per-line

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CNT-008.md

## CNT-009

**The base is broken down by rate and by kind of operation**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: low · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. does this for you.

When one invoice mixes exempt and taxed operations, reverse-charge and ordinary operations, or different VAT rates, the taxable base is shown separately for each. Classify every line on its own; BeeL. groups the breakdown from those classifications.

**Why:** Each part of the base is taxed differently; lumped together, the invoice does not say how much is exempt or at which rate.

**Applies to:** invoice types `STANDARD`, `SIMPLIFIED`, `CORRECTIVE`

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 6.2 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a6

**Incorrect:** Putting an exempt training course and taxed materials on one line at 21 %.

**Correct:** Two lines: the course classified as exempt and the materials at 21 %, each with its own main_tax.

**Related:** CNT-008, CNT-010

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/amounts-and-rounding#taxes-are-rounded-per-group-not-per-line

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CNT-009.md

## CNT-010

**An exempt operation states why it is exempt**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: high · Checked by: Your integration. BeeL. rejects the cases listed under the error codes; the rest is yours to check.

An invoice for an exempt operation refers to the article of the VAT law or of Directive 2006/112/CE that exempts it, or states that it is exempt. Give every 0 % line its exemption_reason, and an exemption_reason_text when the reason is OTRO.

**Why:** Without the reference, a 0 % line reads as a missing tax, not as an exemption.

**Applies to:** invoice types `STANDARD`, `SIMPLIFIED`, `CORRECTIVE`; operations `createCompanyInvoice`

**Error codes:** [`EXEMPT_ZERO_RATE_REQUIRES_REASON`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/EXEMPT_ZERO_RATE_REQUIRES_REASON), [`LINE_EXEMPTION_TEXT_REQUIRED`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/LINE_EXEMPTION_TEXT_REQUIRED)

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 6.1.j) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a6

**Incorrect:** A line at 0 % with no exemption reason: it is rejected with EXEMPT_ZERO_RATE_REQUIRES_REASON.

**Correct:** An educational service exempt under article 20 of the VAT law.

```json
{ "description": "English course, level B2", "quantity": 1, "unit_price": 300, "main_tax": { "type": "IVA", "percentage": 0 }, "exemption_reason": "EXENTA_ART_20" }
```

**Related:** CNT-001, CNT-009, TAX-005

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/tax-classification#mapping-table-beel-api-value--aeat-code · https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/tax-classification#exempt-educational-service-e1

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CNT-010.md

## CNT-011

**Only one original of each invoice exists**

`MUST NOT` · Law · Impact: medium · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Issue a single original of each invoice. A duplicate is allowed only when the same operation has several recipients or the original was lost, and every duplicate carries the word «duplicado».

**Why:** Two originals of one invoice look like two operations to the customer and to an inspection.

**Applies to:** Copies handed over after issue.

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 14.1, 14.2 y 14.4 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a14

**Incorrect:** Issuing the same sale again as a new invoice because the customer lost the first one.

**Correct:** Sending the customer the PDF of the original again, marked «duplicado» if you hand it over as a duplicate.

**Related:** LIF-005, NUM-002

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/invoice-lifecycle#duplicating-an-invoice

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CNT-011.md

## CNT-012

**A reverse-charge invoice carries the mention «inversión del sujeto pasivo»**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: high · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

When the recipient is the one liable for the VAT, the invoice carries the mention «inversión del sujeto pasivo». Classify those lines as reverse charge, and print the mention on any document you render yourself.

**Why:** The mention is what tells the recipient that it has to self-assess the VAT; without it the invoice reads as if VAT had been left out by mistake.

**Applies to:** invoice types `STANDARD`, `CORRECTIVE`; Operations in which the recipient is liable for the VAT (reverse charge).

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 6.1.m) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a6

**Incorrect:** Invoicing construction work for a developer at 0 % VAT with no mention of who pays the tax.

**Correct:** Classifying the line as reverse charge, so the invoice states «inversión del sujeto pasivo».

```json
{ "description": "Building work, phase 2", "quantity": 1, "unit_price": 12000, "main_tax": { "type": "IVA", "percentage": 0 }, "exemption_reason": "ISP_ART_84_2_F" }
```

**Related:** TAX-002, TAX-003, NUM-009

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/tax-classification#inversión-del-sujeto-pasivo-s2

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CNT-012.md

## CNT-013

**A cash-basis invoice carries the mention «régimen especial del criterio de caja»**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: medium · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Invoices for operations under the special cash-basis regime carry the mention «régimen especial del criterio de caja». Make sure it appears on the invoice, and print it on any document you render yourself.

**Why:** The mention tells the recipient that the VAT accrues on payment, which changes when it can deduct it.

**Applies to:** Operations under the special cash-basis VAT regime (regime key 07).

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 6.1.p) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a6

**Incorrect:** Sending regime key 07 and handing over an invoice that says nothing about the cash-basis regime.

**Correct:** Sending regime key 07 and making sure the invoice carries the mention, for example in its notes.

**Related:** TAX-011, CNT-014, CNT-015

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/regime-keys#07--cash-basis-iva-criterio-de-caja

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CNT-013.md

---

## CNT-014

**A used-goods, art or antiques invoice carries its regime mention**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: medium · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Invoices under the special regime for used goods, works of art, antiques and collectors' items carry the corresponding regime mention, and do not show the VAT separately. Make sure both hold on the invoice you hand over.

**Why:** Under this regime the VAT is charged on the margin; showing it apart, or omitting the mention, misstates the tax to the buyer.

**Applies to:** Operations under the special regime for used goods, works of art, antiques and collectors' items (regime key 03).

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 6.1.o) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a6

**Incorrect:** Selling a second-hand car under the margin regime with the VAT broken out on the invoice.

**Correct:** Invoicing it under regime key 03 with the mention «régimen especial de los bienes usados» and the VAT included in the price.

**Related:** CNT-013, CNT-015

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/regime-keys#03--rebu-used-goods-art-antiques

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CNT-014.md

## CNT-015

**A travel-agency invoice carries the mention «régimen especial de las agencias de viajes»**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: low · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Invoices under the special regime for travel agencies carry the mention «régimen especial de las agencias de viajes». Make sure it appears on the invoice you hand over.

**Why:** The mention tells the customer that the VAT is charged on the agency's margin, not on the full price.

**Applies to:** Operations under the special regime for travel agencies.

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 6.1.n) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a6

**Incorrect:** Invoicing a package holiday under the travel-agency regime with no mention of the regime.

**Correct:** Invoicing it with the mention «régimen especial de las agencias de viajes» on the invoice.

**Related:** CNT-013, CNT-014

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/regime-keys#the-catalogue

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CNT-015.md

## CNT-016

**An intra-EU supply of a new means of transport describes the vehicle**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: low · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

An invoice for the intra-EU supply of a new means of transport states its characteristics, the date it first entered service, and the distance or hours travelled until delivery. Put these in the line description.

**Why:** These data are what make the vehicle count as new, which decides where its VAT is paid.

**Applies to:** Supplies of new means of transport to another EU Member State.

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 6.1.k) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a6

**Incorrect:** A line that says only Motorbike.

**Correct:** A line that says Motorbike, 125 cc, first registered 2026-08-01, 150 km at delivery.

**Related:** TAX-004

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CNT-016.md

## CNT-017

**An invoice may be in any language**

`SHOULD` · Law · Impact: low · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

You may issue an invoice in any language. Keep the means to produce a Spanish version, because AEAT may ask for a translation of an invoice in a language that is not official in Spain.

**Why:** An invoice AEAT cannot read in an inspection has to be translated at the issuer's expense.

**Applies to:** The language of the invoice document.

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 12.2 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a12

**Incorrect:** Assuming an English-only invoice can never be asked for in Spanish.

**Correct:** Issuing in English for a foreign customer, knowing the PDF can also be produced in Spanish.

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/branding-and-pdf#choose-template-colour-and-languages

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CNT-017.md

## CNT-018

**Invoices go by email only with the recipient's consent**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: low · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Send invoices electronically only to recipients who have agreed to receive them that way, except where electronic invoicing is mandatory. Record that consent in your own system before emailing invoices.

**Why:** An electronic invoice sent without consent does not count as delivered in the form the law allows.

**Applies to:** operations `sendCompanyInvoice`, `createCompanyInvoiceDelivery`; Electronic delivery of invoices.

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 9.2 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a9

**Incorrect:** Emailing invoices to every customer on file without having asked them.

**Correct:** Asking at sign-up whether the customer accepts invoices by email, and emailing only those who do.

**Related:** DAT-008

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/sending-email#recipients

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CNT-018.md

## CNT-019

**An invoice never totals zero, and only a corrective totals less**

`MUST NOT` · BeeL. rule · Impact: critical · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. rejects a request that breaks it.

Do not create an invoice whose lines add up to zero, and do not use a standard or simplified invoice with a negative total as a credit note. A refund or a reduction is a corrective invoice against the original.

**Why:** An invoice of zero documents nothing, and a negative ordinary invoice is a correction without the link to the invoice it corrects.

**Applies to:** invoice types `STANDARD`, `SIMPLIFIED`; operations `createCompanyInvoice`, `patchCompanyInvoice`

**Error codes:** [`INVOICE_ZERO_AMOUNT`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/INVOICE_ZERO_AMOUNT), [`NEGATIVE_TOTAL_REQUIRES_RECTIFICATIVE`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/NEGATIVE_TOTAL_REQUIRES_RECTIFICATIVE)

**Incorrect:** Creating a STANDARD invoice with a single line of -100 to refund a customer: it is rejected with NEGATIVE_TOTAL_REQUIRES_RECTIFICATIVE.

**Correct:** Issuing a partial corrective against the invoice being refunded.

```http
POST /v1/companies/{company_id}/invoices/{invoice_id}/corrective

{ "rectification_type": "PARTIAL", "rectification_code": "R1", "reason": "Refund of one unit returned by the customer", "lines": [{ "description": "Returned unit", "quantity": -1, "unit_price": 100 }] }
```

**Related:** COR-001, COR-012

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/amounts-and-rounding#amounts-that-are-rejected

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CNT-019.md

---

## CNT-020

**A Spanish recipient's NIF is in the AEAT census**

`SHOULD` · AEAT criterion · Impact: high · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. rejects a request that breaks it.

Check a Spanish customer's NIF against the AEAT census before invoicing it. With VeriFactu enabled, BeeL. refuses to issue to a NIF that AEAT reports as not in the census or revoked, before any number is spent.

**Why:** AEAT accepts a record whose recipient is not in the census only as an error that has to be fixed later; a revoked NIF cannot operate at all.

**Applies to:** invoice types `STANDARD`, `CORRECTIVE`; operations `issueCompanyInvoice`, `validateNif`; VeriFactu enabled.

**Error codes:** [`NIF_NOT_IN_CENSUS`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/NIF_NOT_IN_CENSUS), [`NIF_REVOCADO`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/NIF_REVOCADO)

**Legal basis:**

- AEAT, Validaciones y errores VERI*FACTU (v1.2.2), 4.3.1 Tratamiento de los errores en remisión voluntaria VERI*FACTU — https://www.agenciatributaria.es/static_files/AEAT_Desarrolladores/EEDD/IVA/VERI-FACTU/Validaciones_Errores_Veri-Factu.pdf

**Incorrect:** Issuing to a customer whose NIF and legal name do not match the census: it is rejected with NIF_NOT_IN_CENSUS.

**Correct:** Validating the NIF when the customer signs up, and correcting the legal name or NIF before the first invoice.

```http
POST /v1/nif/validate
```

**Related:** CNT-005, CNT-021, REC-009

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/handling-rejections#recipient-data--fix-the-invoice

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CNT-020.md

---

## CNT-021

**A recipient without a Spanish NIF is identified by an alternative id**

`MUST` · AEAT criterion · Impact: high · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. rejects a request that breaks it.

Identify a recipient without a Spanish NIF with an alternative_id of the type that fits (EU VAT number, passport, official ID, residence certificate, other document or not registered) and its country, never together with a nif. With country ES, only a passport or the not-registered type is accepted.

**Why:** AEAT identifies each recipient either by NIF or by this identifier, never both, and rejects combinations its validations do not allow.

**Applies to:** invoice types `STANDARD`, `CORRECTIVE`; operations `createCompanyInvoice`, `createCompanyCustomer`

**Error codes:** [`RECIPIENT_NIF_AND_ID_OTHER_EXCLUSIVE`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/RECIPIENT_NIF_AND_ID_OTHER_EXCLUSIVE), [`ALTERNATIVE_ID_SPAIN_INVALID_TYPE`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/ALTERNATIVE_ID_SPAIN_INVALID_TYPE), [`RECIPIENT_UNREGISTERED_ID_MUST_BE_DNI_OR_NIE`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/RECIPIENT_UNREGISTERED_ID_MUST_BE_DNI_OR_NIE)

**Legal basis:**

- AEAT, Validaciones y errores VERI*FACTU (v1.2.2), 3.1.3.13 Agrupación Destinatarios — https://www.agenciatributaria.es/static_files/AEAT_Desarrolladores/EEDD/IVA/VERI-FACTU/Validaciones_Errores_Veri-Factu.pdf
- AEAT, Validaciones y errores VERI*FACTU (v1.2.2), 3.1.3.13 Agrupación Destinatarios — https://www.agenciatributaria.es/static_files/AEAT_Desarrolladores/EEDD/IVA/VERI-FACTU/Validaciones_Errores_Veri-Factu.pdf
- Orden HAC/1177/2024, anexo, lista L7 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2024-22138

**Incorrect:** Sending a French company's VAT number in nif together with an alternative_id: it is rejected with RECIPIENT_NIF_AND_ID_OTHER_EXCLUSIVE.

**Correct:** Sending only the alternative identifier, with its type and country.

```json
{ "recipient": { "legal_name": "Dupont SARL", "alternative_id": { "type": "NIF_IVA", "number": "FR12345678901", "country_code": "FR" } } }
```

**Related:** CNT-005, TAX-004, TAX-006

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/international-customers#identifying-foreign-customers · https://docs.beel.es/guides/glossary#alternative-id-types-foreign-customers

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/CNT-021.md
